questions_frozen_before_source_collectio: Confirm exact identity, format, original/reissue/remix status and credited roles.
Find or reuse a meaningful musical context beyond generic profile geography.
Investigate this release: sessions, collaborators, versions and relevant scene or repertoire, retaining scope limits.
Look for an explicitly documented, musically useful connection with another owned release. No genre-only or city-only network inference.
Record source access gaps, active review intervals and a specific stopping decision; do not equate a completed bounded review with complete history.
context_is_not_popularity_rank: Contexts are overlapping triage hypotheses, not an objective fame score or confidence score. Reassess them after research without replacing selected records. EP, single, 12-inch and album are kept separate in format metadata.
selection: Ten per provisional context; frozen candidate pools, stable SHA-256 ranking, no repeated main artist within each context. Established albums first include two each from Hip Hop, Jazz and Funk / Soul where available; fill remaining slots by rank. Earlier batches excluded.
timing: Measure dated source collection separately. Review intervals begin before source reading and stop after adjudication; report elapsed review wall time as an upper bound if tool latency is included. Never reconstruct reading time retrospectively.
stopping: Keep method-0.2 evidence safeguards. Inspect a relevant primary/context lead and targeted alternative before bounded unresolved. A supported context is not permission to infer every session or contributor.
connections: Accept only reviewed pairs of owned releases with explicit identities, roles, relationship type, scope and dated read sources. A common city or genre is not a documented connection.
